title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Intermediate School of Apalit, Pampanga, to Jose Escaler Memorial School, in Honor of the Late Jose Escaler, Who Was Undersecretary of Justice.

text.en:
The Intermediate School of the municipality of Apalit, Pampanga, shall hereafter be known as
Jose Escaler Memorial School, in honor of the late Jose Escaler, an eminent son of said town who was
Undersecretary of Justice.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 29, 1933.
